description: A standard operating procedure document detailing the account opening process, referenced as a related document to the Enhanced KYC Training. This SOP establishes operational controls and procedural requirements for new account establishment.

name: Regulatory Circulars 2026
description: A collection of regulatory circulars issued in 2026, referenced as a related document to the Enhanced KYC Training. These circulars communicate regulatory expectations and requirements relevant to KYC procedures.

name: Enhanced KYC Implementation Register

name: Module 1 — Enhanced KYC Requirements (FCA-COBS-2026-03)
description: A training module designed to prepare staff for FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced Know Your Customer requirements effective 2026-03-01. The module covers the regulatory changes and their operational impact on customer verification processes.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

name: Understand Enhanced KYC Requirements Under FCA-COBS-2026-03
description: Staff must understand the specific enhanced Know Your Customer requirements mandated by FCA-COBS-2026-03 and their effective date of 2026-03-01.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

name: Compliance with FCA-COBS-2026-03 Enhanced KYC Requirements
description: Staff must comply with FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01. This is a regulatory obligation imposed by the Financial Conduct Authority.
context: Prepare affected colleagues for the FCA-COBS-2026-03 enhanced-KYC requirements effective 2026-03-01

name: Enhanced KYC Verification Process
description: The enhanced Know Your Customer verification process required under FCA-COBS-2026-03, effective 2026-03-01. This represents an elevated standard for customer identity and address verification.

name: Beneficial Ownership Verification Above 25%
description: KYC verification requirement to identify and verify beneficial owners with ownership stakes above 25%. This is a core assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.

name: Source of Funds Evidence for Initial Deposits
description: KYC verification requirement to collect and assess evidence of the source of funds for initial deposits exceeding £10,000. This is a mandatory assessed topic in the training program.
context: source-of-funds evidence for initial deposits above £10,000

name: Enhanced Sanctions Screening
description: Enhanced AML screening process for sanctions list checks as part of the assessed training topics. Staff are trained to conduct thorough sanctions screening as a core compliance control.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

name: PEP Screening
description: Enhanced AML screening process to identify and verify politically exposed persons. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

name: Adverse Media Screening
description: Enhanced AML screening process to check for adverse media reports on customers and beneficial owners. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering enhanced due diligence obligations.
context: enhanced sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media screening

name: Financial Crime Referrals and No-Tipping-Off Obligations
description: Compliance obligation requiring staff to file Suspicious Activity Reports for financial crime and maintain confidentiality by not tipping off customers. This is an assessed topic in the training program.
context: Financial Crime referrals and no-tipping-off obligations

name: Quarterly Review Dates
description: Compliance obligation requiring quarterly review of customer accounts and KYC information. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering ongoing monitoring and periodic refresh requirements.
context: quarterly review dates and the account-activation approval gate

name: Account-Activation Approval Gate
description: Compliance control requiring formal approval before account activation. This is an assessed topic in the training program covering account opening procedures and compliance gates.
context: quarterly review dates and the account-activation approval gate
